comments.body: That’s a great implementation of the whole “grader ai” idea. Do you have them running any specific strategies or is the internal arguments enough to make you profitable?

replies.author: andrew363601
replies.body:
Yes correct! PER strategy so initially we receive a signal/alert - and this can come from tradingview/ or the built in strategies that run on javascript which are connected tick by tick to websocket - here the data set or strategy that triggered that alert/signal gets passed as original reasoning along with any data thats shared then the agent pulls new fresh data from other various tools in a tiered structure based from my MD file to build a working thesis. If things line up - approve! otherwise veto but the "reasoning" for that veto is the next signals previous working thesis so even if the agent says NO - it has object permeance knows what asset and strategy its running on and understand the WHY behind the veto. See it knows its future self will read this thesis so it leaves a note in its "ALPHA THESIS" which is what gives is better context on WHEN it feels like it can enter - WAITING - literally hunting for the right conditions to enter. 

It can also choose to update its own veto cool down minuets as well- so it saves on token utilization and not have to wake up the agent everytime it gets a signal so parameters, core memory lessons, new data points and new active thesis - all on one asset/strategy plus the internal logic and reasoning has made me alot more profitable than where this was months ago.

replies.author: Silent-Ninja-869
replies.body: Damn, that seems brilliant and super thought out, congrats! Only thing id consider is to let the agent output a hard price or condition trigger alongside the veto cooldown so your js layer only wakes it when the market actually invalidates or fulfills that waiting thesis, rather than relying on pure time
